values.note: Nine sites book online on MyCountyParks (water/electric 3, 6, 8, 9, 10; full hookup 13, 15, 16, 19), at least 3 days ahead; the rest are first come, first served, and an unoccupied reservable site with no reserved tag is first come too. Holiday-weekend reservations need 4 nights. Reservations are final and non-refundable; one reschedule by phone. Check-in and check-out 3 pm.

booking.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Cherokee/Park/Silver-Sioux-Recreation-Area/Facility/Silver-Sioux-Campsite-10/Availability (read 2026-11-04): '***If you attempt to make a reservation less than 3 days in advance, the site will look unavailable on the online calendar. If the site is not occupied and there isn't a reserved tag hanging, the site is first come, first served. ***', 'You can reserve a minimum of 1 night and a maximum of 14 nights.', 'Memorial Day Weekend, Labor Day Weekend, and the 4th of July will require a 4 night minimum.', 'All campsite reservations with Cherokee County Conservation Board are FINAL and NON-REFUNDABLE', 'You are allowed to reschedule your reservation ONE time', 'Check in/out time is 3:00 PM/3:00 PM'; park page: 'We have 5 electric/water sites and 4 electric/water/sewer sites that are now reservable!'

season.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Cherokee/Park/Silver-Sioux-Recreation-Area/Facility/Campground-Silver-Sioux/Availability (read 2026-11-04): 'Camping: May 1-October 31 PENDING WEATHER CONDITIONS', 'Camping and Barn: Closed November 1- April 30' (the park page says 'Campground & Barn- open from May 1-November 1')

note: Cherokee County Conservation campground northeast of Quimby, near where Silver Creek meets the Little Sioux River; the river runs about 0.6 km north, out of sight of the sites. The full-hookup sites have cement pads. Wi-Fi may not reach every site. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 31 hookup sites (19 full at $30, 12 water/electric pull-throughs at $20), 50 amp, showers, dump, Wi-Fi; added the season (May 1-Oct 31), the online booking rules (9 reservable sites, 3 days ahead, 14-night max, 4-night holiday minimum) and 70-ft site lengths. Not waterfront confirmed. Note trimmed of field facts; 'pull-through' corrected (the full-hookup sites are back-ins).
flags: PHONE: none stored. Cherokee County Conservation Board: 712-225-6709 (campground facility page 'Call us at 712-225-6709 or email us at cherokeeccb@gmail.com'; also the cancellation line on every campsite page). apply.py does not write phone.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. NAIP: the loops sit on a wooded terrace; the Little Sioux River's nearest bend is ~600-700 m north beyond woods, and a small stream ~250 m east beyond the gravel road (Silver Sioux Road) and woods. No site is at or in view of the river or an oxbow.
PIN: stored 42.64794,-95.59145 is in the open meadow ~165 m south-west of the loops (under the 250 m line). The pads centre at ~42.6493,-95.5900 if a re-pin is wanted.

AMPERAGE WORDING: the facility page's fee list says the pull-throughs are 'Electric (30 amp)' while its site list and the Activity page say 50 amp; harmless for the field (the full-hookup sites are 50 amp).
